judgment.rationale: The duplicate label and old candidates are insufficient after newer comments added a text-mapping crash and assignment corruption. Current evidence decides whether #49644 handled it.
evidence: The original 0.99.1 report includes a ZIP and intermittent shortcut failure.
Later comments include an engine abort, a KeePass/text-insertion trigger, and a 0.100.2 0xc0000409 crash.
The newest commenter reports text assignment values becoming blank and a workaround of reopening/resaving.
PR #49644 fixed a Quick Accent false-activation key-up path after 0.100.2, and stable 0.101.2362.0 released later.
judgment.recommended_action: Request a current stable retest and fresh /bugreport after any remaining crash, plus Quick Accent state and whether resaving the mapping changes behavior.

issue_context.summary: Keyboard Manager text-insertion shortcuts intermittently stop or crash the engine, with older logs, a KeePass trigger, and reports that saved assignments became blank.
known_information: Restarting or toggling Keyboard Manager restores operation temporarily.
The issue is labeled duplicate and originally cited #38089 and #47978.
#38089 gained a deterministic Quick Accent cause and merged fix #49644, then reopened because it fixed only part of reports.
The newest crash evidence is from 0.100.2, not current stable.
inferences: Some earlier stoppage may be handled by the Quick Accent fix.
Blank assignments and 0xc0000409 may be a separate profile or injection problem, but this is unproven.
issue_context.analysis: Closing as duplicate would discard newer unmatched evidence; designing from mixed old versions would be speculative. A current retest and immediate diagnostic are decision-changing.
initial_investigation: Reviewed all six comments, duplicate candidates, and linked #48268.
Verified current stable postdates the fix and found no fix for blank mapping values.

comment.body: Thanks for the original report ZIP, crash log, KeePass trigger, later Event Viewer `0xc0000409` entry, and the observation that text assignments became blank. PR #49644 fixed one Quick Accent false-activation path after 0.100.2, so please first retest on current 0.101.2362 or newer. If the engine still crashes, repair one affected mapping, reproduce once, and add a comment containing `/bugreport` immediately afterward; also state whether Quick Accent was enabled and whether reopening/saving that mapping changes the result. Please do not post private replacement text.
